subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — Acme Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acmehealth.com>, Ben Harris <ben.harris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — Acme Health

Hi Laura / Ben —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum with the evaluation.

Key pain points you mentioned:
- Extremely sensitive PHI & strict audit requirements (SOC2 + HIPAA).
- Inconsistent inference latency across your current stack causing timeouts in clinician workflows.
- High per-token cost on peak days with large batch inference.

Goals for the bake-off / evaluation:
1) Validate latency and tail percentiles (<150ms median, <350ms 95th for 1k concurrent sessions).
2) Prove comparable or better answer fidelity vs incumbent (we'll use your 50-case prompt suite).
3) Demonstrate operational controls: private deployment option, KMS-backed key management, and detailed audit logs.
4) Show unit-cost improvements via batching/cache without degrading latency.

Competitive context (vendors you said are under consideration): Redwood, OmniHealth, NovaNet — we've captured the decision criteria in the attached matrix.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll send the bake-off matrix (attached) and a short POC plan by EOD.
- Can we lock a 60–90 minute technical POC with your infra + security folks next week (suggest Wed 11/11 or Thu 11/12)? This will include a perf test (concurrent sessions), a correctness run on your prompt suite, and a security review checklist.
- Procurement: you mentioned a standard NDA + SOW. If procurement can share their template, we can review during the tech call.

Attachments: Redwood-bakeoff-matrix.xlsx (bake-off criteria & proposed tests), SOC2-summary.pdf (Redwood SOC2 scope + contact).

If that plan looks good I’ll coordinate calendars. Appreciate the candid feedback today — happy to tighten the plan to match your timelines.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — this is perfect and covers what we discussed.

Couple clarifications from our side:
- The prompt suite is 50 clinical triage prompts + 20 multi-turn follow-ups. We care about hallucination rates for medication/diagnosis related outputs.
- Security: procurement will want evidence of key rotation practices and a sample audit log showing user-level events.
- Timeline: we’re hoping to complete the bake-off within three weeks so we can present recommendations at our 11/24 steering meeting.

Tech POC availability: Wed 11/11 10:00–11:30 PT works for our infra/security. We’ll invite our platform engineer (Ben) and our GC lead (procurement will drop a placeholder).

Can you also include an itemized estimate for a 30-day Dedicated trial (GPU reservation + support) so procurement has rough numbers before the call?

Appreciate the matrix — please share the test harness we’ll run against our prompt set.

—Laura

Laura / Ben / Procurement team —

Great — locking Wed 11/11 10:00–11:30 PT for the tech POC. Calendar invite will follow. Couple quick items we’ll bring to the session:

1) Test plan overview (attached matrix): perf test (1k concurrent sessions simulated), 95th/99th latency, token-cost benchmarking across burst/steady states.
2) Correctness tests: we’ll run your 50-case prompt suite and flag hallucination/omission rates; we recommend a small blind evaluation panel (your clinicians) for ground truth.
3) Security checklist: KMS integration, key rotation cadence, audit log sample, data residency options.

Procurement note: rough Dedicated 30-day trial estimate: $35k–$45k depending on GPU class and peak throughput needs. I’ll put a more detailed cost table in the follow-up doc and include a sample SOW.

Action items before the POC (owner):
- Acme: share prompt suite + any PII redaction guidance (Laura / Ben)
- Redwood: send test harness + containerized perf runner + cost table (Aditya)
- Procurement: share NDA / SOW template if you want Redwood legal to align before the call (Procurement)

If anyone needs different timing, shout — otherwise I’ll send invites and the perf runner link.

Best,
